useCase.name: Place an admitted student in a class and section, and invite their guardian to its parent group
useCase.featureRef: 27.3 Class placement of an admitted student

intent.name: student.place
intent.summary: Place an admitted student into a class and section, which puts them on the register, makes them markable for attendance and sends their guardian the section's group link. One step, one student or a whole cohort.

routesHere.gloss: put Ayesha into Grade 4 section B

routesHere.gloss: place the students who are waiting for placement

routesHere.gloss: split these twenty-four children between 4-A and 4-B

routesHere: place the imported students who came in without a class

routesHere.gloss: put this child in section C, from 15 September

request.gloss: move Bilal from section A to section B

routesElsewhere.note: A student already placed is moved, with a reason, not placed again (BR-12, E4).

request.text: is bache ka admission kar do
request.gloss: admit this child

routesElsewhere.note: Placement does not create the student record. The record exists from the moment the admission was approved (BR-1).

request.text: guardian ko group ka link dobara bhejo
request.gloss: send the guardian the group link again

request.text: section ki capacity badha do
request.gloss: raise the section's capacity

routesElsewhere.note: A full section refusing a placement is the capacity working (BR-4). Raising it is a separate decision about the room.

request.text: agle class mein promote kar do
request.gloss: promote them to the next class

routesElsewhere.note: Promoting students at session end is out of scope here.

steps.note: One step, whether the request names one student or twenty-four. The register entry, the attendance start date, the fee liability and the guardian's group invite all follow inside it — there is no sequence to plan.

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Capacity, the placement date, whether the student is already placed and whether the guardian has a contact at all are enforced by the API and arrive as errors. A failed invite does not fail the placement (E6), and a guardian with no contact number does not either (E9) — both are outcomes to report.
plan.atomicity: Each placement is atomic in itself: the enrolment, the register entry, the section's placed count and the audit entry together or not at all. Across a batch the guarantee is different — each student is placed individually and one failure does not abandon the rest (BR-9, AC-8), so a partial result is the normal shape. The guardian's group invite is separate again and does not block: where the section holds no stored link, or the send fails, or the guardian has no number, the placement still stands and the gap is recorded rather than hidden (BR-8, BR-10, AC-3, AC-9). Report all three layers.

operations.name: student.place
operations.idempotencyKey: student_id + session_id, since a student holds one active placement per academic session (BR-12) and a repeat returns ALREADY_PLACED rather than opening a second enrolment
operations.purpose: Place one or more students awaiting placement into a section, opening the enrolment and sending each guardian the section's stored group link.

parameters.name: student_ids

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No student matches, or none awaiting placement — an already-placed student is a move, not a placement.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with student ID and approved class. For a set, report how many and who before anything is placed.

parameters.notes: One student or several, all at status Registered and awaiting placement (BR-9). Students who arrived by bulk import with no class appear in the same list and are placed the same way (A6).

parameters.name: section_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No active section of that name, or none under a class this student may go into.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with their remaining capacity.

parameters.notes: The section to place into, resolved from how the actor named it. It must belong to the chosen class and have remaining capacity (BR-4). The class is derived from the section by the backend — never send both.

parameters.name: placement_date
parameters.notes: Not before the admission date and not in the future (E2, E3). Attendance is markable from this date, not from the admission date — a child admitted in August and placed in September was not absent for a month (BR-6, AC-5).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: A per-student result, because one failure does not abandon the rest.

fields.name: placed
fields.description: student_id, section_name, placement_date, invite_delivery_status.

fields.name: failed
fields.description: student_id and the reason. Listed rather than silently dropped (BR-9).

fields.name: section_placed_count
fields.description: After the batch. May now equal capacity, in which case the section shows as Full.

fields.name: section_remaining
fields.description: Places left.

fields.name: invites_sent
fields.description: How many guardians were sent the section's stored link (BR-8).

fields.name: invites_not_sent
fields.description: student_id and why — no stored link on the section, no guardian contact, or a failed send. Visible rather than silent (BR-10).

fields.name: class_differs_from_approved
fields.description: Where a student was placed into a class other than the one approved at admission, recorded because the family was told a class (BR-3, A3).

errors.meaning: The section filled between the list being read and the placement.
errors.note: Message: "Section B filled while you were placing. Choose another section." Choosing another is the actor's decision.

errors.meaning: The placement date is before the admission date.
The placement date is in the future.
errors.note: Message: "Choose a placement date of today or earlier." Never substitute today's date.

errors.meaning: The student already holds an active placement this session.
errors.note: Message names the current section and asks for a reason to move them. A student holds one active placement per session (BR-12) — placing them again is student.move, which is a different capability and a different decision.

errors.meaning: Every section of the approved class is full.
errors.note: Message: "Every section of Grade 4 is full. Choose another class, or raise a capacity." Both are the actor's decisions.

errors.meaning: The student record was deactivated since the list was read.
The group invite could not be sent.
errors.written: The placement, the enrolment and the register entry all stand.
errors.notWritten: The guardian has not received the group link.
errors.note: Not a failure of the placement. Report both halves — the link can be resent (A5).

errors.meaning: The guardian holds no contact number.
errors.written: The placement stands and records that no invite was sent.
errors.note: Report it. The gap is meant to be visible, and adding a contact is a correction to the student record (UC-03-01).

planningRules.rule: Report who a set resolves to, by name, before the plan is emitted. Placement puts children on registers, starts their attendance, makes them billable and sends their guardians into a WhatsApp group — none of which is undone by a later move.
Send section_id and never class_id. The section determines its class, and sending both invites them to disagree — a student on one class's register and another's section.

Never choose the section. Where the request names none, ask; where the named one is full, E1 and E7 say so and the alternatives come back for a person to pick from. Which room a child sits in is not a planner's decision.

Never substitute the placement date. Attendance is markable from it (BR-6), so a date invented here decides whether a child was absent for a month. E2 and E3 refusing one are the system asking a person to say when the child actually started.

Never treat ALREADY_PLACED as a reason to place again. A student holds one active placement per session (BR-12); moving them is a different capability that closes the old enrolment and needs a reason (BR-7).

Report the three layers separately: who was placed, who failed and why, and whose guardian was not sent the link. A batch reported as a success hides both the failures BR-9 insists on listing and the guardians who are not in the group (BR-10).

Report class_differs_from_approved whenever it comes back. The family was told a class at admission (BR-3), and placing the child into another one is permitted but is something somebody has to tell them.
Never chain a capacity change onto a full section. Raising a capacity to fit one more child is a decision about the room, and admission checks the same number (BR-4).
branch_id and session_id come from $session.

reversal.statement: A placement is never deleted (BR-11). A student placed in error is moved through student.move, with the move recorded and its reason kept — the previous enrolment row is closed rather than edited, so the history of where a child sat survives. The guardian has already been sent the group link and the system does not remove anybody from a WhatsApp group (BR-10). The controller must not attempt a compensating call.

request.text: Ayesha ko Grade 4 section B mein daal do, aaj se
request.gloss: put Ayesha into Grade 4 section B, from today

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town branch, academic session 2025-26. Today is 08-09-2026. Ayesha was admitted on 20-08-2026 and is at Registered.

steps.note: section_id alone; the class is derived from it (PR-2). The date comes from "aaj" in the request.

resolvedPlans.outcome: Ayesha is on the 4-B register, markable for attendance from 08-09-2026 and not before (BR-6, AC-5), billable against Grade 4's fee structure, and her record has moved to the Enrolled Student List. Her guardian has been sent 4-B's stored group link.

request.text: in chaubees bachon ko 4-A mein place kar do
request.gloss: place these twenty-four children into 4-A

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town branch. 4-A has 22 places left.

steps.note: The 24 names are reported to the actor before the plan is emitted (PR-1). Each is placed individually inside the batch (BR-9).

resolvedPlans.outcome: 22 placed, 2 listed under failed with SECTION_FILLED. The batch was not abandoned for the two and neither was quietly put elsewhere (AC-8). Report all three numbers, plus any guardian who was not sent the link.

request.text: jo students import se aaye the aur unki koi class nahi thi, unko 5-A mein daal do
request.gloss: place the students who came from the import with no class into 5-A

resolvedPlans.context: Staff, Johar Town branch. The section holds no stored WhatsApp link.

steps.note: Imported students with no class appear in the same awaiting-placement list and are placed the same way (A6).

resolvedPlans.outcome: The students are placed and on the register. invites_not_sent lists every one of them with the reason: the section holds no stored group link (BR-10, AC-3). Report that — the placements succeeded and no guardian is in a group, which is exactly the gap BR-10 keeps visible.

request.text: is bache ko place kar do

routesElsewhere.note: The system does not administer the WhatsApp group and does not remove anybody from one (BR-10, AC-10). Somebody has to do it by hand.

request.text: class band kar rahe hain, sab bachon ko shift kar do
request.gloss: we are closing the class, move all the children

routesElsewhere.note: Each move needs its own reason (BR-7). There is no bulk move — see PR-2.

steps.note: One step. The previous enrolment row is closed rather than edited, so the history of where a child sat survives (BR-7, BR-11).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Capacity on the receiving section, and whether a reason was given, are enforced by the API and arrive as errors.
plan.atomicity: One write, atomic in itself: the old enrolment closed, the new one opened, both registers updated, both sections' placed counts adjusted and the audit entry, together or not at all. The previous row is closed rather than edited (BR-7), so the record shows a child in one section until a date and another after it. The new section's group link is sent (BR-10); the student is **not** removed from the old WhatsApp group, because the system does not administer it — and the record says so (AC-10). Report that: the guardian is now in two groups.

operations.name: student.move
operations.idempotencyKey: student_id + section_id + session_id, so a repeat does not close and reopen the enrolment twice or send the group link again
operations.purpose: Close a student's current enrolment and open one in another section, sending the new section's group link.

parameters.name: student_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No student matches, or none currently placed — a student awaiting placement is placed, not moved.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with student ID and current section.

parameters.notes: A student currently placed. Resolved from how the actor named them.

parameters.name: section_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No active section of that name, or none under a class this student may go into.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with their remaining capacity.

parameters.notes: The section to place into, resolved from how the actor named it. It must belong to the chosen class and have remaining capacity (BR-4). The class is derived from the section by the backend — never send both.

parameters.name: move_reason
parameters.notes: Maximum 250 characters. Required (BR-7, E5). The actor's own words — the reason is kept with the closed enrolment and is what someone reads when they ask why a child changed section mid-year.

parameters.name: move_date
parameters.notes: When the move takes effect, so attendance reads correctly on both registers. Omit where the request names none and the API uses today.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: The move, and what it did and did not do.

fields.description: The section they came off.

fields.name: section_name
fields.description: The section they are on now.

fields.name: previous_enrolment_status
fields.description: Moved out. Closed, not edited (BR-7).

fields.name: move_reason
fields.description: As given, kept with the closed enrolment.

fields.name: invite_delivery_status
fields.description: The new section's group link, sent to the guardian (BR-10).

fields.name: removed_from_old_group
fields.description: Always false. The system does not administer WhatsApp groups and has not removed them (BR-10, AC-10).

fields.name: previous_section_remaining

errors.meaning: A move was attempted with no reason.
errors.note: Message: "Give a reason for moving this student." Ask for it; never compose one.
The student stays where they are. Choosing another section is the actor's decision.

errors.meaning: The student holds no active placement to move from.
errors.note: They are awaiting placement, which is student.place — a different capability.

planningRules.rule: Never compose the move reason. It is kept with the closed enrolment and is what someone reads when they ask why a child changed section mid-year (BR-7). E5 refusing the move without one is the system insisting a person supply it.
Never plan a move for a set. Each move has its own reason, closes its own enrolment and sends its own guardian a new group link; a batch with one reason describes none of them.

Report that the student has not been removed from the old WhatsApp group. The system does not administer the group and never will (BR-10, AC-10), so the guardian is now in two — and unless somebody is told, nobody removes them.

Never move a student to free up a place. A section at capacity refusing a placement is the capacity working; moving an existing child out to fit a new one is a decision about two families, not a workaround.
Send section_id and never class_id. The section determines its class.

Never treat NOT_PLACED as a reason to place instead. A student awaiting placement has never been on a register, and placing them is a different act with no reason required and no old enrolment to close.
branch_id and session_id come from $session.

reversal.statement: A placement is never deleted and a move is not undone (BR-11). Moving the student back is another move, with its own reason, and the record then shows three enrolment rows — which is correct, because that is what happened. The guardian has been sent two group links and removed from neither group. The controller must not attempt a compensating call.

request.text: Bilal ko 4-A se 4-B mein shift kar do — walidain ne subah wali shift maangi hai
request.gloss: move Bilal from 4-A to 4-B — the parents asked for the morning shift

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town branch, academic session 2025-26.

inputs.move_reason: Parents asked for the morning shift.

steps.note: The reason is the actor's own, carried across (PR-1).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Bilal is off the 4-A register and on the 4-B register (AC-6). The 4-A enrolment is closed with the reason, not edited, so the history shows where he sat until today. His guardian has 4-B's group link — and has not been removed from 4-A's group, which is worth saying out loud (AC-10).

request.text: is bache ko 4-C mein daal do
request.gloss: move this child to 4-C

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town branch, with no reason given in the request.

steps.note: No plan is emitted: move_reason is required and has nothing to take it from (PR-1).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Nothing is written. Ask why the child is moving. This is the ordinary case — BR-7 requires a reason because a child changing section mid-year is something the school has to be able to explain.

request.text: 4-C bohat bhari ho gayi hai, chaar bachon ko 4-D mein shift karo
request.gloss: 4-C has got too crowded, move four children to 4-D

steps.note: One plan per child, and the four children have to be named first. There is no bulk move, because each carries its own reason and its own guardian message (PR-2).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Ask which four children. Then four separate plans, each reported — four enrolments closed, four opened, four guardians sent 4-D's link and none removed from 4-C's group.

intent.name: section.group.invite.resend
intent.summary: Send a section's stored WhatsApp group link again to a placed student's guardian, when they say it never arrived. One step.

routesHere.gloss: send the guardian the group link again

routesHere.text: Bilal ke walid ko section ka link phir bhej do
routesHere.gloss: send Bilal's father the section link again

routesHere: the invite failed when we placed her — send it again

request.text: section ka link badal do
request.gloss: change the section's link

routesElsewhere.note: Replacing the stored link is a change to the section. This sends the one that is already stored.

request.text: saare guardians ko naya link bhejo
request.gloss: send the new link to all the guardians

routesElsewhere.note: Nothing re-invites guardians in bulk. Replacing a link does not re-invite those already placed (UC-27-02 BR-9), and the use case's open question asks whether it should.

request.text: guardian ka number theek kar do
request.gloss: correct the guardian's number

routesElsewhere.note: Where the invite has nowhere to go, the contact is corrected on the student record.

request.text: guardian ko group se nikaal do
request.gloss: remove the guardian from the group

routesElsewhere.note: The system does not administer the group (BR-10).

steps.note: One step. The link sent is the one currently stored against the student's section — not the one that was stored when they were placed, if it has since been replaced (UC-27-02 BR-9).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Whether the section holds a stored link, and whether the guardian has a contact number, are enforced by the API and arrive as errors.
plan.atomicity: One write: a further send against the section's stored link, with its own log entry and delivery status. The placement, the enrolment and the stored link are all unchanged. Nothing else is touched.

operations.name: section.group.invite.resend
operations.idempotencyKey: student_id + section_id + the send timestamp, so a repeat does not inflate resend_count
operations.purpose: Send the guardian of a placed student the WhatsApp invite link currently stored against their section.

parameters.name: student_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No placed student matches within the actor's row scope.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with student ID and current section.

parameters.notes: A placed student whose guardian is to be sent the link.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: The send, and which link went.

fields.name: student_id
fields.description: The student whose guardian was sent it.

fields.name: section_name
fields.description: The section the link belongs to.

fields.name: link_replaced_since_placement
fields.description: True where the stored link has changed since this student was placed. The guardian receives the current one, which may be a different group from the one their child's classmates joined.

fields.name: delivery_status
fields.description: Queued until the provider says otherwise.

fields.name: resend_count
fields.description: How many times this guardian has been sent it.

errors.meaning: The section holds no stored group link.
errors.note: There is nothing to resend. Storing one is section.group.link.set, and it is a change to the section rather than a step towards this.

errors.meaning: The guardian holds no contact number.
errors.note: Adding a contact is a correction to the student record (UC-03-01), never a number supplied in passing.
Report it. Repeating the call does not make it arrive.

planningRules.rule: Never store a link to make a resend possible. NO_STORED_LINK means the section never had one and every guardian placed into it is outside the group (UC-27-02 BR-10) — that is a bigger thing than one family's missing invite, and storing a link the actor did not supply invents a group.
Report link_replaced_since_placement when it comes back true. The guardian is being sent the current link, which may be a different group from the one their child's classmates joined (UC-27-02 BR-9).
Never repeat the call to make a failed send arrive. Each attempt is logged, and a run of identical entries says only that somebody kept trying.
Never substitute a number. Where the guardian has no contact, the fix is a correction to the student record with a number somebody supplied — not one taken from a sibling's record or a message.
branch_id comes from $session.

reversal.statement: A message cannot be unsent. The placement and the stored link are unchanged by it, so there is nothing else to undo.

request.text: Ayesha ke walid ko group ka link dobara bhej do, unko mila nahi
request.gloss: send Ayesha's father the group link again, he did not get it

resolvedPlans.context: Staff, Johar Town branch. Ayesha is placed in 4-B, which holds a stored link.
resolvedPlans.outcome: 4-B's stored link is queued to the guardian again and the send is logged (A5). resend_count moves to 2, and the placement is untouched.

request.text: is bache ke guardian ko link bhejo
request.gloss: send this child's guardian the link

resolvedPlans.context: Staff, Johar Town branch, on a student placed in a section that has never had a link stored.

steps.note: Emitted unchanged. The API returns NO_STORED_LINK (E6).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Nothing is sent. Report that the section holds no group link at all — so every guardian placed into it is outside the group, not just this one (PR-1). Somebody has to create the group and store its link.

request.text: Bilal ke guardian ko link bhejo
request.gloss: send Bilal's guardian the link

resolvedPlans.outcome: The current link is sent, and link_replaced_since_placement comes back true. Report that: Bilal's guardian is being invited to a group that may not be the one his classmates' parents joined (PR-2).
